name: emulate system calls and file io in the vm
definition: map the syscall-visible host operations so the interpretation can read/write files via the host fs
failure_mode: an unsupported syscall blocks the frame-saving

name: boot and bring a Linux/legacy OS under qemu to an operational login
definition: Launch a QEMU VM from a distribution ISO or legacy installer, drive install to a login screen, and wait until the guest is ready and reachable.
failure_mode: the emulated guest fails to boot, the disk image is invalid, or the guest never reaches a running state.
